title: Monitor cognitive load as well as productivity
text: Brooks’s supplied opinion piece raises the possibility that people use saved time to take on more work and supervise more parallel activity. It is a prompt to investigate workload, concentration and learning during rollout rather than assume faster generation automatically improves employee experience.
qualification: Opinion with secondary study references, not independently verified empirical evidence here. The article’s personality typology and social predictions are not used as diagnoses.
